IEM Market Tracker V1

How to use this tracker

Use the tracker as a secondary-market reference for IEM pricing. Search for an IEM, check its estimated Market Value, then click into the individual page to inspect the underlying listings and decide whether the estimate looks trustworthy.

Market Value

Closed sales are the primary signal: the tracker uses a 90-day closed-sale average when there are at least 3 clean samples, then a recency-weighted closed-sale fallback when recent data is sparse. When closed-sale data is sparse, at least 2 independent active/stale asks aged 180+ days can cap the estimate as a discounted unsold-ask ceiling; they do not count as sold samples.

Liquidity / Confidence

The same score appears on the main page and each individual IEM page. It combines included sample count, recency, recent sample depth, source diversity, and price consistency into a 0–100 badge.

High Medium Low

Marketplace View

Use the marketplace toggle to compare the combined market against Reddit-only or Head-Fi-only data. The selected source carries into individual IEM pages.

  • This tool is still in development, so matching errors, missed bundles, stale/unsold statuses, and pricing mistakes can happen.
  • Always click through to the source listing and verify condition, accessories, seller history, currency, and whether the item is actually still available.

Search & Filters

Search by IEM name, brand, model keyword, driver config, or release year. Press Enter to open the first match.
